abstract: We propose a model of costly voting in a canonical spatial setting that reconciles key empirical features of electoral turnout. We integrate citizens with prosocial voting motives who realize higher payoffs from voting when (i) they expect more fellow supporters to vote, (ii) such votes collectively matter more for winning probabilities, and (iii) they care more about which candidate wins. We establish existence of Nash equilibria satisfying an additional condition that ensures equilibria correspond to those in a finite setting with many voters. We derive how electoral primitives—e.g., voter ideology, voting costs, elite polarization, expected closeness—affect outcomes such as turnout, turnout rates, and winning margins. We relate the predictions to empirical findings both from existing studies and our original data work. With all three prosocial motive components, our model reconciles the empirical regularities qualitatively and quantitatively; while existing models fail on multiple dimensions.
title: An Empirically-Grounded Theory of Voting Based on Prosocial Motives

abstract: We study the role of officeholders in the formation of political preferences during childhood. Leveraging data on 200 million registered voters and a regression discontinuity design based on U.S. gubernatorial elections, we show that state governors systematically shift voters’ partisan alignment toward their own party. The effects are concentrated among individuals who were between the ages of 6 and 17 during a governor’s tenure. Each additional year of exposure to a Republican governor during childhood increases the probability of Republican registration in adulthood by 0.45 percentage point. We also document lasting impacts on primary participation and survey-based attitudes. The effects are systematically stronger in settings where governors enjoy greater institutional authority, especially over education and budgeting, and when they are more popular.
title: Hey, Governors, Leave Them Kids Alone: Political Influence During Childhood

abstract: Why do some cultures go extinct while others prevail? In this paper, we show that a society's risk of cultural extinction, proxied by language loss, is shaped by its ancestral gender norms and by how these norms differ from those of competing cultures. Using the Ethnologue and the Male Dominance Index for a global sample of languages, we start by showing that languages from more gender-equal societies face a higher likelihood of extinction than those from male-dominant societies. We propose a conceptual framework in which male-dominant societies are more expansionist via two channels: (i) military capacity sustained through surplus extraction, and (ii) demographic pressure through women's specialization in domestic and reproductive labor. As a result, they expand at the expense of more gender-egalitarian groups. We test this prediction in two empirical settings. Leveraging European colonization as a natural experiment, we find that Indigenous societies with more gender-equal norms than their colonizers are more vulnerable to cultural extinction. We examine alternative pre-colonial societal arrangements and find that cultural extinction is best explained by asymmetries in male dominance rather than in hierarchy or dominance more broadly. Exploiting local variation in neighboring groups' gender structure across Africa, we further show that languages from gender-egalitarian societies are less likely to survive in grid cells located close to male-dominant neighbors, with military capacity and population pressure predicting language expansion across the continent.
title: Male Dominance and Cultural Extinction

abstract: We propose a discrete Fourier transform (DFT)-based test for detecting structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects (IFE). When structural changes are present but ignored, the conventional asymptotic distribution of the least squares (LS) estimator of Bai (2009) may no longer provide reliable inference, and the resulting residuals contain signals of parameter instability. Our test exploits this feature by comparing the DFT of weighted residuals to the flat (zero) spectrum implied under the null hypothesis of no structural change. We establish the theoretical properties of the test, including its asymptotic null distribution and its local and global power, and propose a bootstrap procedure for valid inference in finite samples. Notably, the proposed test can detect a class of local alternatives converging to the null at the rate of N − 1 / 2 T − 1 / 2 , matching the convergence rate of the slope estimators, where N and T are the cross-sectional and time dimensions, respectively. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the excellent performance of the proposed test across various types of structural changes in both factor loadings and slope coefficients. We further illustrate the empirical relevance of our method by applying it to the environmental Kuznets curve and the relationship between health expenditure and income. Our findings highlight the importance of accounting for structural changes in panel data models with IFE.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种基于离散傅里叶变换（DFT）的检验方法，用于检测具有交互固定效应（IFE）的面板数据模型中的结构变化。当存在结构变化但被忽略时，Bai（2009）的最小二乘（LS）估计量的传统渐近分布可能不再提供可靠的推断，由此产生的残差中包含了参数不稳定性的信号。我们的检验利用这一特性，将加权残差的DFT与无结构变化原假设下隐含的平坦（零）谱进行比较。我们确立了该检验的理论性质，包括其渐近零分布以及局部和全局功效，并提出了一种自助法程序，以在有限样本中进行有效推断。值得注意的是，所提出的检验能够检测一类以N−1/2T−1/2速率收敛于零假设的局部备择假设，这与斜率估计量的收敛速率相匹配，其中N和T分别代表截面维度和时间维度。蒙特卡洛模拟表明，所提出的检验在因子载荷和斜率系数的各种结构变化类型下均表现出优异的性能。我们进一步通过将其应用于环境库兹涅茨曲线以及健康支出与收入之间的关系，展示了我们方法的实证相关性。我们的发现强调了在具有IFE的面板数据模型中考虑结构变化的重要性。
title: Testing for structural changes in panel data models with interactive fixed effects via discrete Fourier transform
title_zh: 基于离散傅里叶变换的面板数据交互固定效应模型结构变化检验

abstract: Over the past four decades, the negative relationship between income and fertility in the United States has flattened. We document two additional patterns: fertility variation within income groups has increased, and the average preference for children among high income women has risen. We propose a novel channel through which heterogeneity in fertility preferences interacts with changes in the wage and price structures to reshape the income–fertility relationship as documented. To assess its quantitative importance, we develop an overlapping generations model with heterogeneity in productivity and fertility preferences, alongside existing mechanisms from the literature. The model reproduces the joint evolution of fertility rates, fertility variation, and fertility preferences, and shows that the proposed mechanism is important for changes in fertility behavior across the income distribution.
abstract_zh: 过去四十年间，美国收入与生育率之间的负相关关系已趋于平缓。我们记录了两个额外现象：收入群体内部的生育率差异有所增加，以及高收入女性对子女的平均偏好上升。我们提出一个新渠道，通过该渠道，生育偏好的异质性与工资及价格结构的变化相互作用，重塑了所记录的“收入-生育”关系。为评估其量化重要性，我们构建了一个包含生产率和生育偏好异质性，并融合文献中现有机制的世代交叠模型。该模型再现了生育率、生育率差异及生育偏好的联合演变，并表明所提出的机制对于收入分布上生育行为的变化具有重要意义。
title: Changes in the Fertility of Highly Skilled Women: Accounting for Heterogeneity in Preferences for Children
title_zh: 高技能女性生育率的变化：考虑子女生育偏好的异质性

abstract: Do cultural mindsets shape cooperation? Individualists, who view people as independent, and collectivists, who see them as interconnected, make different decisions that impact governance and economic outcomes. This study tests individualism and collectivism (I/C) in indefinitely repeated prisoner’s dilemmas (IRPD) among in- and out-group members. We hypothesized that collectivists would cooperate more with in-group members, while individualists would treat all groups similarly. To explore causality, participants completed a group-identity task before the I/C measure in Strong-Identity treatment, but not in Weak-Identity treatment. Results show largely null I/C effects; only higher defection payoffs consistently reduced cooperation. Some evidence supports the Strong-Identity treatment leading to lower defection in groups exhibiting greater cohesion in the group-identity task.
abstract_zh: 文化心态是否塑造合作行为？个人主义者视个体为独立存在，而集体主义者则视其为相互关联，这两种不同的观念会导致影响治理和经济结果的决策差异。本研究在无限重复囚徒困境（IRPD）中，针对群体内与群体外成员，测试了个人主义与集体主义（I/C）的影响。我们假设集体主义者会更多与群体内成员合作，而个人主义者则对所有群体一视同仁。为探究因果关系，在强身份处理组中，参与者在完成I/C测量前先执行群体身份任务；而在弱身份处理组中则无此任务。结果显示，I/C效应大体上不显著；唯有更高的背叛收益持续降低了合作率。部分证据支持强身份处理组在群体身份任务中表现出更高凝聚力的群体中，导致背叛率下降。
journal: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
title: Do individualists and collectivists cooperate differently?
title_zh: 个人主义者与集体主义者的合作方式是否不同？

abstract: This paper studies the large market implications of impersonal wage competition. There are finitely many categories of firms and workers, and firms compete for workers by offering uniform wages. We first characterize the unique mixed strategy Nash equilibrium of large replica economies with supermodular preferences. Competition is local: firms only compete with others like themselves, either within the same category or one category above. As the market size grows, the equilibrium converges rapidly to the firm-optimal competitive equilibrium. For general preferences, Nash equilibria converge to competitive equilibria as the market becomes arbitrarily large. We identify a condition on preferences which ensures that the limiting equilibria differ from the firm-optimal competitive equilibrium. Our analysis highlights how the interaction between preference structure and pricing flexibility governs whether uniform wage posting leads to suppressed or inflated wages in large markets.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了非人格化工资竞争在大市场中的含义。存在有限类别的企业和工人，企业通过提供统一工资来竞争工人。我们首先刻画了具有超模偏好的大型复制经济中唯一的混合策略纳什均衡。竞争是局部性的：企业仅与同类企业竞争，要么在同一类别内，要么在上一类别中。随着市场规模的增长，均衡迅速收敛至企业最优竞争均衡。对于一般偏好，当市场变得任意大时，纳什均衡收敛至竞争均衡。我们识别了一个关于偏好的条件，该条件确保极限均衡不同于企业最优竞争均衡。我们的分析强调了偏好结构与定价灵活性之间的相互作用如何决定统一工资报价在大市场中导致工资被抑制还是膨胀。
title: Matching and Price Competition in Large Markets
title_zh: 大规模市场中的匹配与价格竞争

abstract: The wildland–urban interface (WUI) refers to zones where buildings intersect with undeveloped wildland vegetation, and identifying its ecological effects is crucial for understanding human–environment conflicts in relation to landscapes. Current WUI assessments have focused primarily on areas with high-density human activity in developed countries, with limited evidence of vegetation degradation in ecologically vulnerable regions with rapid increases in human activity, e.g., the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau (QTP). We mapped the WUI at a 100-m resolution from 2000 to 2020 on the QTP and quantified vegetation greenness degradation within WUI expansion areas based on the normalized difference vegetation index (NDVI), leaf area index (LAI) and solar-induced chlorophyll fluorescence (SIF), using propensity score matching (PSM) to control for environmental covariate bias and a difference-in-differences (DiD) approach to eliminate background temporal trends, thereby quantifying the net suppressive effect of WUI expansion on vegetation.The results revealed that the WUI area expanded by 48% over the 20-year period, and the expansion was concentrated mainly at the western, southern, southeastern, and eastern margins of the QTP. Urban expansion had a mean total contribution of 89.6% to WUI expansion, approximately 9 times that of wildland. LAI degradation was 11.57%, NDVI degradation was 2.48%, and SIF degradation was 2.06%; all three indicators exhibited consistent degradation directions, confirming that the impact of WUI expansion on vegetation is dominated by leaf area loss and canopy structural simplification. Direct land conversion is the primary driver of LAI degradation, which proceeds through multiple pathways including direct clearing, landscape reorganisation with fragmentation amplification, and the concentration of grazing pressure.
abstract_zh: 城乡交错带（WUI）指建筑物与未开发野生植被相交的区域，识别其生态效应对于理解人类与环境的景观冲突至关重要。当前WUI评估主要聚焦于发达国家高密度人类活动区域，而对生态脆弱且人类活动快速增加地区（如青藏高原）的植被退化证据有限。本研究以100米分辨率绘制了2000至2020年青藏高原WUI分布图，并基于归一化植被指数（NDVI）、叶面积指数（LAI）和太阳诱导叶绿素荧光（SIF）量化了WUI扩张区域内的植被绿度退化，采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）控制环境协变量偏差，并运用双重差分（DiD）方法消除背景时间趋势，从而量化WUI扩张对植被的净抑制作用。结果表明，20年间WUI面积扩张了48%，扩张主要集中在青藏高原西部、南部、东南部和东部边缘。城市扩张对WUI扩张的平均总贡献率为89.6%，约为野生植被扩张贡献的9倍。LAI退化率为11.57%，NDVI退化率为2.48%，SIF退化率为2.06%；三项指标均呈现一致的退化方向，证实WUI扩张对植被的影响以叶面积损失和冠层结构简化为主要特征。直接土地转换是LAI退化的主要驱动因素，其作用通过多种途径实现，包括直接清除、伴随破碎化放大的景观重组以及放牧压力的集中化。

title: Declining greenness under the rapid expansion of the wildland–urban interface on the Qinghai-Tibetan Plateau
title_zh: 青藏高原城乡交错带快速扩张下的绿地衰退现象

abstract: Falling agricultural prices have been found to generally increase armed civil conflict in producing regions, but not the risk of the most lethal conflicts – civil wars. This column shows that the evidence for civil-war onset is consistent with the broader evidence on armed civil conflict when agricultural price indices isolate changes in world prices from changes in countries’ exports. Across 118 countries over 1957–2007, a one standard deviation decline in world agricultural prices raised the risk of civil-war onset by around 30%, with larger effects in sub-Saharan Africa. The evidence points to falling producer incomes, rather than rising consumer food prices, as the mechanism.
abstract_zh: 研究发现，农产品价格下跌通常会加剧产粮地区的武装冲突，但并不会增加最致命冲突——内战的风险。本文专栏指出，当农业价格指数将世界价格变动与各国出口变动区分开来时，关于内战爆发的证据与更广泛的武装冲突证据相一致。在1957年至2007年间覆盖118个国家的研究中，世界农产品价格每下降一个标准差，内战爆发的风险约增加30%，且在撒哈拉以南非洲地区影响更为显著。证据表明，其作用机制在于生产者收入下降，而非消费者食品价格上涨。
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为118个国家的世界农产品价格与内战爆发关系，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景，核心应用非中国。
title: World agricultural prices and the outbreak of civil war
title_zh: 世界农产品价格与内战爆发
